Hi Laura — welcome, and thanks for sending the initial docs. Looping in Marissa (vendor data) and Kimberly (AP) so we can move this through.

To get EchoGrid fully provisioned in our vendor master and enable PO issuance, we need the following items (short checklist):
1) Confirmed legal name for master record (exact capitalization/punctuation) — you listed "EchoGrid, Inc." which is fine, please confirm DBA if any.
2) Completed vendor portal registration — I'll send a portal invite after we create the skeleton profile.
3) Completed ACH form with bank account + voided check (we accept encrypted upload or SFTP).
4) Completed beneficial ownership / UBO attestation (required for vendors incorporated outside certain states).
5) Primary invoice routing email and PO acceptance contact (name, title, phone).
6) Payment terms preference (Net30 / Net45 / Prepaid) and any early-pay discount terms.

Target timeline: Once we have items 1, 3, and 4 we can create the vendor record and issue a test PO within 2 business days.

Marissa/Kimberly — can one of you confirm additional attributes we require for Redwood's ERP mapping (tax region, remit-to address formatting, and AP contact field name)?

Laura — can you confirm whether EchoGrid has a preferred remit address different from the incorporation address? If so, please attach a PDF. If you prefer to upload ACH details, let me know and I'll share the secure upload link.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Laura — got everything, thanks for the fast turnaround. A couple quick items and next steps: 

- Marissa will validate the W-9 and Certificate; Kimberly will review the ACH sheet once submitted.
- I'll provision the skeleton vendor profile in our vendor portal this afternoon using the legal name you confirmed (EchoGrid, Inc.). You will receive an auto-invite to complete the portal registration (please use the same email for invoices to avoid duplicate records).
- For DocuSign: we prefer you sign our standard vendor agreement for suppliers on variable payment schedules. I'll open a DocuSign envelope and paste the link here once ready.

Please send the ACH form to the secure upload link when ready (I will email SFTP credentials if preferred). If EchoGrid has any contract redlines, send them to contracts@redwood.ai.

- Laura: upload ECHOGRID_ACH_Form.xlsx + voided check (by EOD)
- Marissa: validate tax docs and UBO attestation
- Kimberly: confirm ERP field mapping and PO routing after ACH submission
- Mina: provision vendor skeleton & send DocuSign link

Invoices should not be sent to Redwood until you receive confirmation that the vendor record is active. Once active, please send invoices to invoices@redwood.com and include our PO number in the subject.

Thanks again — we'll follow up with the DocuSign link in ~1 hour.
